question: Which of the following sports is played by Anthony Amalraj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Table Tennis**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Anthony Amalraj is an Indian **table tennis player**. 
 
• He has represented India in various international tournaments, including the **Commonwealth Games** and the **Asian Games**. 
 
• Amalraj has been one of the prominent players in Indian table tennis, competing in both men's singles and doubles events.
 
• His achievements include winning **several national titles** and being part of India's table tennis team in various **international competitions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton**:

 
 
• **Famous Players**: P.V. Sindhu, Saina Nehwal, Kidambi Srikanth
 
• Badminton is a **racquet sport** where players (singles or doubles) compete to hit a shuttlecock over a net.
 
• It is particularly popular in India, with multiple international titles won by Indian players.
 
 
 
• Squash:
 
 
• Famous Players: Dipika Pallikal, Saurav Ghosal
 
• Squash is an indoor racquet sport where players hit a small rubber ball against a front wall.
 
• The goal is to keep the ball in play while trying to make it difficult for the opponent to return.
 
 
 
• Golf:
 
 
• Famous Players: Jeev Milkha Singh, Anirban Lahiri
 
• Golf is an outdoor ball sport where players use clubs to hit a ball into a series of holes on a course.
 
• The objective is to complete the course in the fewest strokes.
